subject.title: Sub-agent startup silence: no first-progress signal, aborted runs appear as hangs

question: Should OpenClaw add explicit `first-progress` and `startup-failed` lifecycle phases for sub-agent startup, or solve the silent-startup-abort problem within the existing lifecycle/status model?
rationale: The report is source-reproducible, but the proposed repair creates new core lifecycle semantics that need owner acceptance across gateway, session, SDK, and subagent consumers.

options.title: Accept explicit lifecycle phases
options.body: Review the open candidate PR or a replacement that adds the phases with compatibility tests and real startup-failure proof.

options.title: Use existing lifecycle/status semantics
options.body: Require a narrower fix that preserves the current phase set while making startup aborts visible and non-hanging.

options.title: Reject core lifecycle expansion
options.body: Document an external watchdog/workaround and close the associated lifecycle PRs if maintainers do not want this core API surface.

recommendation.title: Accept explicit lifecycle phases
recommendation.body: Review the open candidate PR or a replacement that adds the phases with compatibility tests and real startup-failure proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main lifecycle and gateway projection changes point to @vincentkoc as the best available routing owner for accepting or rejecting the core lifecycle shape.
